title: WC_HW_E \!= CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE static assert documents critical invariant
description: A wc_static_assert2 at top of port.c verifies that WC_HW_E and CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE are distinct values, because the port uses CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE for 'fall back to software' and WC_HW_E for 'stop with error' semantics. Per CLAUDE.md this assert is mandatory for every port. A contributor might remove it as 'obvious' or because the values have never collided in practice. The assert must be preserved: if wolfSSL ever changed these error code assignments to collide (unlikely but possible during major version bumps), the silent failure mode would be that hardware errors cause fallback-to-software rather than failures, with no diagnostic.
